items.title: What Amcor (AMCR)'s Dividend Raise Means For Shareholders
items.summary: Amcor recently raised its quarterly dividend to $0.66 a share while lowering its 2026 earnings outlook. Its dividend payout reached 156% of free cash flow over the twelve months to September 2026, alongside higher leverage and a plan to reduce net debt to about 3x by the end of 2027. The combination of a higher dividend, reduced earnings guidance and elevated leverage highlights pressure on Amcor's cash generation.
